nodes.text: Hold. Let them smell you first. Right. Now we can talk.

choices.text: How do you gentle a wild thing?

nodes.text: Three stalls to a household, one friend at your heel. Swap them here. Rest one that limped home. And when a bond has run its course, this is where you slip the collar.
Wear its fight down first. Not out. Down. Then offer what it wants from your pack and kneel. Keep your hands steady and it will follow you home.
Depends on the belly. Beetles come for berries. A rat wants an egg, whole, no cracks. Ask Hobb, he farms by the pasture, what the rats take already.
Carrying water is simple too and people still drop the pail. Bears are not simple. Keep your feet where you can use them.
Kept droves forty years. People call hunters cruel, but a hunting beast is spoken to all day. A yard beast is counted. I know which one comes when I whistle.
Gate on your way out. They notice.
